name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 37 – Am 111
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 37a. Stresses that revenue from competition fines should not be used to justify an increase in Union expenditure but should instead be used to ease the financial burden on Member States and their taxpayers through a corresponding proportional reduction to their national contributions to the Union budget;
